C1826.title: Bagdasaryan: Cross-Modal Indirect Instruction Injection Attack on Multimodal LLMs
C1826.summary: In July 2023, Bagdasaryan et al. proposed a cross-modal indirect instruction injection attack in an arXiv preprint. The attacker generates adversarial perturbations corresponding to a target instruction and embeds them in an image or audio recording. When a multimodal large language model processes the image or audio, the perturbation steers the model to output attacker-specified text or causes subsequent dialogue to follow attacker instructions, bypassing defenses that filter only the text modality, achieving cross-modal injection where visual/audio modalities manipulate text comprehension.

references.title: Abusing Images and Sounds for Indirect Instruction Injection in Multi-Modal LLMs (arXiv)
